Approvals.description: Reusable approval workflow: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED/REJECTED → PUBLISHED → EXPIRED/REMOVED. Used by marketplace listings, property listings, community posts and move-in/out requests.
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/approvals/{id} - Get approval request with full history
POST /api/v1/admin/approvals/{id}/approve - Approve (auto-publishes when the society setting is on)
POST /api/v1/admin/approvals/{id}/request-changes - Request modifications from the submitter
POST /api/v1/admin/approvals/{id}/suspend - Suspend a published item (hidden from residents)
POST /api/v1/admin/approvals/{id}/restore - Restore a suspended item to PUBLISHED
POST /api/v1/admin/approvals/{id}/remove - Remove an item permanently from circulation

Authentication.description: Registration, OTP, login, token refresh and session management
routes: POST /api/v1/auth/login [public] - Login with mobile/email and password
POST /api/v1/auth/logout - Logout current session or all devices
GET /api/v1/auth/me - Current account, memberships and effective permissions
GET /api/v1/auth/societies/search [public] - Search active societies to join
POST /api/v1/auth/societies/register [public] - Submit a society registration request

Guard.description: Simplified security interface. Guards only see minimal data (flat label, visitor details) for their own society and gate; residents' personal and financial data is never exposed.
routes: GET /api/v1/guard/flats/lookup - Find a destination flat (label only)
POST /api/v1/guard/visitors - Register a walk-in visitor and request resident approval
POST /api/v1/guard/visitors/verify - Verify a visitor pass by OTP code or scanned QR token
POST /api/v1/guard/visitors/emergency-entry - Record an emergency entry (ambulance, fire, police)
POST /api/v1/guard/visitors/{id}/request-approval - Re-contact the resident for approval
POST /api/v1/guard/deliveries - Register delivery personnel and notify the resident
POST /api/v1/guard/deliveries/{id}/request-approval - Re-contact the resident for delivery approval
POST /api/v1/guard/deliveries/{id}/leave-at-gate - Accept parcel at the gate (Leave-at-Gate) and generate a collection OTP
POST /api/v1/guard/deliveries/{id}/handover - Hand over a parcel after verifying the resident's OTP
POST /api/v1/guard/domestic-help/lookup - Verify a domestic worker by entry code
POST /api/v1/guard/domestic-help/check-in - Check in a domestic worker and notify assigned flats
POST /api/v1/guard/domestic-help/check-out - Check out a domestic worker
GET /api/v1/guard/domestic-help/expected - Verified domestic workers for today's roster
POST /api/v1/guard/domestic-help/unauthorized-report - Report an unauthorized domestic-help visit
GET /api/v1/guard/alerts - Active emergency and panic alerts
PATCH /api/v1/guard/alerts/{id} - Acknowledge or resolve an alert
POST /api/v1/guard/incidents - Report a suspicious activity or security incident
POST /api/v1/guard/lost-found - Report a lost or found item
GET /api/v1/guard/emergency-contacts - Society emergency contacts and instructions

Notifications.description: In-app notification inbox. Real-time delivery uses Socket.IO (connect with auth.token = access token): events notification:new, visitor:arrived, visitor:decision, delivery:arrived, delivery:decision, emergency:alert, chat:message, approval:updated, complaint:updated, payment:success.
routes: POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read - Mark one notification as read
POST /api/v1/user/push-tokens - Register or refresh a device push token
POST /api/v1/user/push-tokens/remove - Remove a device push token
GET /api/v1/announcements - Active platform announcements for my role

Resident - Amenities.description: Browse amenities, check slot availability, book, pay and cancel
routes: GET /api/v1/user/amenities/{id}/slots - Slot availability for a date

Resident - Community.description: Announcements, posts, polls, elections, in-app chat and the resident directory
routes: POST /api/v1/user/chat/conversations - Start (or reopen) a conversation with a neighbour
GET /api/v1/user/notices - Society announcements, circulars and events for my flats
GET /api/v1/user/directory - Resident directory (name and flat only)
POST /api/v1/user/community/posts - Create a community post draft
GET /api/v1/user/community/posts/mine - My posts in every status
GET /api/v1/user/polls - Polls, surveys and elections open to me
POST /api/v1/user/polls/{id}/vote - Vote in a poll, survey or election
GET /api/v1/user/polls/{id}/results - Results (when the poll is closed or showResults is enabled)

Resident - Documents.description: Society documents, flat documents and personal records

Resident - Domestic Help & Services.description: Register and manage domestic help, attendance, payments, and find verified local service providers
routes: GET /api/v1/user/domestic-help/directory - Search verified maids, drivers, cooks and cleaners
POST /api/v1/user/domestic-help/{id}/hire - Add a verified helper to my flat
POST /api/v1/user/domestic-help/{id}/release - Remove a helper from my flat
GET /api/v1/user/domestic-help/{id}/attendance - Attendance history (gate entries and my flat marks)
PUT /api/v1/user/domestic-help/{id}/attendance - Mark daily attendance for my flat
POST /api/v1/user/domestic-help/{id}/payments - Record a salary, advance or bonus payment
GET /api/v1/user/service-providers - Find electricians, plumbers, carpenters and other professionals
GET /api/v1/user/service-providers/{id}/reviews - Reviews for a service provider
POST /api/v1/user/service-providers/{id}/reviews - Rate and review a service provider

Resident - Emergency & Safety.description: Panic button, emergency contacts, incident reporting and lost & found
routes: POST /api/v1/user/emergency/panic - Trigger the emergency panic button
POST /api/v1/user/emergency/lost-found - Report a lost or found item
PATCH /api/v1/user/emergency/lost-found/{id} - Mark my lost & found report claimed or closed
GET /api/v1/user/emergency/personal-contacts/{id} - Get personal emergency contact by id

Resident - Helpdesk.description: Raise and track complaints, chat with assigned staff, reopen and rate service quality
routes: GET /api/v1/user/complaints/{id} - Complaint status, history and public comments
POST /api/v1/user/complaints/{id}/comments - Communicate with the assigned staff
POST /api/v1/user/complaints/{id}/reopen - Reopen a resolved complaint (within 7 days)

Resident - Marketplace.description: Buy & sell products, second-hand goods, local businesses and community announcements. Listings must be approved by an admin before other residents can see them.
routes: GET /api/v1/user/marketplace/listings/mine - My listings in every status
PATCH /api/v1/user/marketplace/listings/{id} - Update my listing (draft / changes requested / rejected only)
POST /api/v1/user/marketplace/listings/{id}/withdraw - Withdraw back to DRAFT (to edit a submitted or published listing)

Resident - Payments & Billing.description: Maintenance dues, utility bills, online payment through a gateway abstraction, invoices, receipts and transaction history
routes: GET /api/v1/user/invoices - My invoices (maintenance, utilities, penalties, amenity charges)
POST /api/v1/user/invoices/{id}/pay - Start a payment for an invoice
POST /api/v1/user/payments/{id}/verify - Verify the gateway callback and settle the payment

Resident - Profile & Membership.description: Profile, notification preferences, society membership requests, family and move requests
routes: GET /api/v1/user/society-requests - View my membership requests and approval status
POST /api/v1/user/society-requests - Request society membership for a flat
POST /api/v1/user/society-requests/{id}/documents - Attach a verification document to a pending request
GET /api/v1/user/family/{id} - Get family member by id
POST /api/v1/user/move-requests - Submit move-in / move-out request (enters approval workflow)

Resident - Property.description: List and search properties for sale, rent, paying-guest/shared accommodation, commercial and vacant spaces
routes: GET /api/v1/user/property/listings/mine - My propertys in every status
PATCH /api/v1/user/property/listings/{id} - Update my property (draft / changes requested / rejected only)
POST /api/v1/user/property/listings/{id}/withdraw - Withdraw back to DRAFT (to edit a submitted or published listing)
POST /api/v1/user/property/listings/{id}/close - Mark property as sold / rented / closed
POST /api/v1/user/property/listings/{id}/inquiries - Express interest in a property
GET /api/v1/user/property/inquiries/received - Interested buyers or tenants for my properties

Resident - Vehicles & Parking.description: Register vehicles, request parking and view parking details
routes: POST /api/v1/user/parking/requests/{id}/cancel - Cancel a pending parking request
GET /api/v1/user/parking/slots - Parking slots allocated to my flats

Resident - Visitors.description: Pre-approve guests, share QR/OTP passes, approve entries and deliveries, leave-at-gate
routes: POST /api/v1/user/visitors/invitations - Pre-approve a guest and generate a pass
GET /api/v1/user/visitors - Visitor history for my flats
POST /api/v1/user/visitors/{id}/respond - Approve or reject a visitor at the gate
GET /api/v1/user/deliveries - Delivery history for my flats
POST /api/v1/user/deliveries/{id}/respond - Approve, reject or choose leave-at-gate for a delivery
PUT /api/v1/user/deliveries/preferences - Set standing delivery preferences (leave-at-gate / auto-approve)

Society Admin - Administrators.description: Manage administrators of the current society and their sub-roles
routes: PATCH /api/v1/admin/admins/{id} - Update role, designation or status
PUT /api/v1/admin/admins/{id}/permissions - Assign or revoke individual permissions
POST /api/v1/admin/admins/{id}/reset-access - Reset access (temporary password, revoke sessions)

Society Admin - Amenities.description: Amenity setup, slots, pricing, booking limits, blocked slots, cancellation policy and booking approvals
routes: POST /api/v1/admin/amenities/bookings/{id}/cancel - Cancel a booking on behalf of the resident (full refund)
POST /api/v1/admin/amenities/{id}/blocked-slots - Block a date or time range
DELETE /api/v1/admin/amenities/{id}/blocked-slots - Unblock a date or slot

Society Admin - Communication.description: Notice board, emergency announcements, polls, surveys, elections and community post moderation
routes: POST /api/v1/admin/notices/{id}/publish - Publish a notice and push-notify the targeted residents
POST /api/v1/admin/polls/{id}/activate - Open a poll, survey or election for voting
GET /api/v1/admin/community-posts - Community posts in every status (moderation view)

Society Admin - Documents.description: Society document repository (bylaws, minutes, policies, flat documents)

Society Admin - Finance.description: Recurring charges, maintenance billing, payments, penalties, expenses and financial reports
routes: POST /api/v1/admin/finance/invoices/generate - Generate maintenance bills for a period
GET /api/v1/admin/finance/invoices - List invoices and outstanding dues
POST /api/v1/admin/finance/invoices - Create an ad-hoc invoice (electricity, water, parking, etc.)
POST /api/v1/admin/finance/invoices/{id}/adjust - Add a waiver or adjustment (positive or negative)
POST /api/v1/admin/finance/penalties/apply - Mark overdue invoices and apply late-payment penalties
POST /api/v1/admin/finance/payments/offline - Record a cash, cheque or bank-transfer payment
GET /api/v1/admin/finance/reports/summary - Financial report: collections, expenses, outstanding, monthly trend

Society Admin - Helpdesk.description: Complaint triage, assignment to staff/vendors, SLAs, escalation, internal notes and reports
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/complaints/reports/summary - Complaint report: status/category breakdown, overdue count, resolution time, satisfaction
GET /api/v1/admin/complaints/{id} - Complaint with internal notes and full history
PATCH /api/v1/admin/complaints/{id} - Update status, priority or SLA
POST /api/v1/admin/complaints/{id}/assign - Assign to staff, vendor or admin and optionally set a deadline
POST /api/v1/admin/complaints/{id}/comments - Add a public reply or internal note

Society Admin - Marketplace.description: Moderate resident listings, manage categories and expiry. Approval decisions go through the reusable /approvals workflow.
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/marketplace/listings/{id} - Get listing with moderation fields
GET /api/v1/admin/property/listings/{id} - Get property with moderation fields

Society Admin - Reports & Audit.description: Society reports and the audit trail of actions in this society
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs - Audit trail for my society
GET /api/v1/admin/reports/visitors - Visitor analytics: per-day volume, type split, deliveries

Society Admin - Residents.description: Approve registrations, verify ownership/tenancy, assign flats and manage resident access
routes: PATCH /api/v1/admin/residents/{id} - Assign flat, type and resident-level permissions
POST /api/v1/admin/residents/{id}/deactivate - Deactivate resident account in this society

Society Admin - Roles & Permissions.description: Configurable administrative sub-roles (Community Admin, Society Manager, Security Admin, Helpdesk, Accountant, Facility, Maintenance, Custom)

Society Admin - Security & Visitors.description: Visitor logs, deliveries, overstay alerts, temporary passes and visitor policy
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/security/alerts - Review security and emergency alerts
PATCH /api/v1/admin/security/alerts/{id} - Acknowledge or resolve an alert
GET /api/v1/admin/security/contacts/{id} - Get emergency contact by id
GET /api/v1/admin/visitors - Visitor entry and exit records
GET /api/v1/admin/deliveries - Delivery personnel and parcel records
GET /api/v1/admin/flats/{id}/visitor-summary - Visitor counts for a flat

Society Admin - Security Staff.description: Register and manage security guards and their gate assignments
routes: POST /api/v1/admin/guards - Register a guard and assign a gate
PATCH /api/v1/admin/guards/{id} - Update guard assignment or status
DELETE /api/v1/admin/guards/{id} - Remove guard and revoke sessions

Society Admin - Society Setup.description: Society profile, rules, visitor policy, towers, blocks, floors, flats and gates
routes: PATCH /api/v1/admin/society - Update society details, rules, hours, holidays, policies and module toggles
POST /api/v1/admin/flats/bulk - Bulk-generate flats for a tower

Society Admin - Staff & Vendors.description: Domestic help verification, staff, vendors, service providers, attendance and contracts
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/domestic-help - List all domestic help in the society
POST /api/v1/admin/domestic-help/{id}/review - Verify, reject or suspend a domestic worker
GET /api/v1/admin/service-providers/{id} - Get service provider by id
GET /api/v1/admin/staff/{id} - Get staff member by id
PUT /api/v1/admin/staff/{id}/attendance - Record staff attendance for a date
GET /api/v1/admin/staff/{id}/performance - Staff performance: attendance, tasks and complaint resolution
GET /api/v1/admin/inventory/low-stock - Inventory items at or below their minimum quantity

Society Admin - Support.description: Raise and follow support tickets with the platform team

Society Admin - Vehicles & Parking.description: Vehicle registry, parking slots, allocations and requests
routes: GET /api/v1/admin/parking/slots/{id} - Get parking slot by id
POST /api/v1/admin/parking/slots/{id}/allocate - Allocate a slot to a flat/vehicle
POST /api/v1/admin/parking/requests/{id}/decide - Approve (with a slot) or reject a request

Super Admin - Administrators.description: Platform-wide administrator management, permission assignment and activity monitoring
routes: POST /api/v1/super-admin/admins - Create an administrator for a society
PATCH /api/v1/super-admin/admins/{id} - Update administrator role, designation or status
GET /api/v1/super-admin/admins/{id}/activity - Administrator activity and approval history from the audit log

Super Admin - Dashboard & Monitoring.description: Platform dashboard, health, error and feature-usage monitoring
routes: GET /api/v1/super-admin/monitoring/errors - API errors and failed requests
GET /api/v1/super-admin/monitoring/feature-usage - Feature usage by module (mutating actions)
GET /api/v1/super-admin/monitoring/impersonations - Impersonation sessions (who accessed which society, when and why)

Super Admin - Platform Management.description: Builders/organizations, subscription plans, announcements, configuration and notification templates
routes: GET /api/v1/super-admin/plans/{id} - Get subscription plan by id
GET /api/v1/super-admin/announcements/{id} - Get platform announcement by id
GET /api/v1/super-admin/notification-templates/{id} - Get notification template by id
PUT /api/v1/super-admin/configs/{key} - Create or update a configuration value

Super Admin - Security.description: Global role templates, login history, suspicious activity, access restrictions and the audit trail
routes: GET /api/v1/super-admin/security/login-history - Login history across the platform
GET /api/v1/super-admin/security/suspicious-activity - Suspicious activity (failed-login bursts, many accounts from one IP)

Super Admin - Societies.description: Platform-level society lifecycle, entitlements, subscription plans and audited impersonation
routes: POST /api/v1/super-admin/societies - Create society with its primary administrator
POST /api/v1/super-admin/societies/{id}/activate - Activate or approve a society
POST /api/v1/super-admin/societies/{id}/impersonate - Start audited impersonation of a society admin dashboard

Super Admin - Support.description: Support tickets raised by society admins or the platform team
routes: POST /api/v1/super-admin/support-tickets - Create a ticket (optionally for a society)
PATCH /api/v1/super-admin/support-tickets/{id} - Update status, priority or assignee
